title: kate-core: store indent folds on the view
summary: apply_indent_folds writes View.folds from indent_folds. A trailing newline counts as one line, the same count as TextBuffer::line_count. new_view still starts with an empty list. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the tests. It does not need a window or the owner's eyes.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: indent_folds counts lines the same way as TextBuffer::line_count. str::lines drops the empty line after a trailing newline. Add that blank line when the text is empty or it ends with a newline. A blank line still does not start or end a fold. The text a, newline, two spaces, b, newline yields the span 0..3. The existing fold tests stay green. apply_indent_folds writes View.folds. Each span becomes a CharRange from the first scalar of start to the first scalar of end. When end is the line count, the end offset is the scalar count. For that text the range is 0..6. new_view still starts with an empty fold list. Leave workspace.rs unchanged. Update the folds field comment. Leave indent.rs and lib.rs unchanged. Leave session.rs, lib.rs, and files.rs in kate-ui unchanged. PKT-0051 owns those files. Leave bar.rs unchanged. PKT-0067 owns that file. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: fold::tests::a_trailing_newline_counts_as_a_line
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. indent_folds exists, and a trailing newline is not a line today. The text a, newline, two spaces, b, newline yields exactly the span 0..3.

regression_tests.name: view::tests::apply_indent_folds_stores_char_ranges
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because apply_indent_folds does not exist. The same text stores one CharRange from offset 0 to offset 6.
